title.en: EchoSparse: Letting Last Step's Statistics Steer This Step, Approximating at Multiple Resolutions Instead of Dropping, and Packing Sparse Attention Tightly
title.zh: EchoSparse：复用上一去噪步的统计量，用多级近似代替丢弃，并打包稀疏 attention 的计算

dek.en: Building on PISA and Sol-Attn, EchoSparse uses the previous denoising step's LSE as a fixed softmax offset and its block masses to allocate 1, 4 or 64 columns per KV block instead of dropping any, then packs the fragmented representative columns into wide GEMM tiles and overlaps data movement with compute.
dek.zh: EchoSparse 在 PISA 和 Sol-Attn 的基础上做了三项改动：把上一去噪步的 LSE 作为 softmax 的固定偏移；按块质量给每个 KV 块分配 1、4 或 64 列，所有块都参与计算；把零碎的代表列拼成更宽的 GEMM tile，并让数据搬运与计算重叠。

teaser_alt.en: EchoSparse on Wan2.1-14B: 1.70× faster than FlashAttention-4 on a B200, closer to the dense video than Sol-Attn and PISA
teaser_alt.zh: EchoSparse 在 Wan2.1-14B 上：B200 上比 FlashAttention-4 快 1.70 倍，比 Sol-Attn 和 PISA 更接近稠密结果
